summary: Reproduced the candidate's current-device validation bug, preserved numeric CUDA/version rejection hardening, validated against each input tensor's device, and pinned the independently validated native SM8x shared-memory/local-KV correction. The candidate's exact-target rejection of SM89 was removed because later native evidence demonstrated SM86 cubins executing on SM89 and identified a shape-specific kernel defect instead.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate d1f6440 failed 6 cases: both wrappers used is_fa3_supported(None) instead of the cuda:1 tensor device, and the exact-target predicate rejected SM87/SM89 despite same-major SM8x cubin compatibility evidence. Twenty other contract cases passed.

26 source-wrapper/CMake tests passed, covering input-device forwarding, rejection before native dispatch, numeric CUDA versions, the documented FA3-only selector, SM8x compatibility, and the corrected dependency pin/hash.
Changed Python source and regression tests compile.
Downloaded dependency commit archive matches the new CMake SHA256 98cbb200b5057db2b4a40fdd80fb6eae65e784c751ce6d05a9b220f70b797879.

gpu_execution_evidence: Prepared torch is 2.11.0+rocm7.2 with torch.version.cuda=null. No NVIDIA GPU, nvcc, cuobjdump, or CUDA flash_ops build is available; mocked device objects were used only to test wrapper routing.
remaining_limitations: This job did not execute CUDA kernels or independently reproduce SM89 numerical results; the pinned dependency's PR reports 22/22 direct native CUDA cases on RTX 4090D SM89.
A complete sgl-kernel wheel containing dependency commit 149a54916c6a1b940f7ff1afd95f078349a9c471 was not rebuilt in the ROCm-only prepared environment.
The native dependency correction and upstream version-contract PR are still open at delivery time; this mirror PR pins the reviewed dependency commit directly.
No claim is made for Hopper performance or for future architectures beyond capability 9.0.
